package: @astryxdesign/lab # CommentPin Interactive anchor for comments over content or in margins. Pass every distinct participant, the total thread count, and the unread thread count; keep coordinates, clustering, collisions, thread state, and opened UI in the host. Absolute coordinates map to the logical bottom-start corner, while another pin is selected its siblings use isDimmed and remain interactive, and activating the selected pin again clears the host selection. **Import:** `import {CommentPin} from '@astryxdesign/lab';` ## Anatomy | Element | Required | Description | |---------|----------|-------------| | Marker surface | Yes | The compact speech-bubble button surface, with a fixed 2px logical bottom-start corner, 28, 32, or 36px tall by size and padded equally on every side. It owns selected, resolved, disabled, hover, press, focus-visible, and grouped presentation, but no coordinates. | | Representative avatars | Yes | One Avatar for a single thread. A group shows its distinct participants as an AvatarGroup capped at three circles: up to three Avatars, or two Avatars plus the overflow indicator when more than three people participate. Avatars are decorative inside the marker; the button label owns accessibility. | | Overflow indicator | No | An ellipsis AvatarGroupOverflow circle that takes the third position when a group has more than three distinct participants. It shows no number, so the group count stays the pin’s only number. Decorative and non-interactive inside the pin. | | Group count | No | Exact total number of represented threads. Appears when threadCount is greater than one, before the unread dot when there is one; it is a quantity, not ordinal identity. Extra end padding keeps it clear of the pin’s edge. | | Unread dot | No | An accent StatusDot at the end of the pin that marks unread activity whenever unreadCount is above zero: after the group count, or after the participant on a single-thread pin. It adds no second number; decorative inside the pin. | ## Best Practices - **Do:** Pass the lead commenter first and write a complete action label, including unread context. - **Do:** Use threadCount as quantity, never ordinal identity; pass unreadCount so an accent dot marks unread work. - **Don't:** Nest interactive Avatars, slice participants to fake the overflow, or pass coordinates/grouping logic into the marker. ## Accessibility - **Native button activation:** CommentPin is one native button. Tab reaches an enabled pin; Enter and Space activate it. A disabled pin stays in the tab order and is announced as disabled through aria-disabled, and every activation path is blocked. - **Selected state and name:** The required label is the button name and tooltip. aria-pressed communicates controlled selection; participant Avatars, the overflow circle, the visible thread total, and the unread dot remain decorative, so repeat grouped and unread context in label. - **Selection and focus:** The solid 2px accent outline hugs the pin while the shared focus-visible outline sits farther outside it, so selection and keyboard focus remain distinguishable; forced colors uses the platform Highlight treatment. Verify both selected and selected-plus-focused states against the host surface. ## Props | Prop | Type | Default | Description | |------|------|---------|-------------| | `label` | `string` | - | required action name + hover/focus tooltip; include grouped/unread context **(required)** | | `participants` | `readonly [CommentPinParticipant, ...CommentPinParticipant[]]` | - | non-empty ordered tuple of {id,name,avatarSrc?}; single renders 1; groups render ≤3 circles (2 + ellipsis overflow beyond 3 distinct) **(required)** | | `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'sm'` | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' = 28/32/36px height, 22/24/28px avatars, equal padding; default 'sm' | | `threadCount` | `number` | `1` | positive integer total; >1 selects grouped presentation; default 1 | | `unreadCount` | `number` | `0` | unread represented threads; >0 shows an accent dot after the total (or the avatar on a single pin); capped at threadCount; default 0 | | `isSelected` | `boolean` | `false` | controlled active pin; solid 2px accent outline outside the pin + aria-pressed; host clears it when the selected pin is activated again | | `isDimmed` | `boolean` | `false` | controlled de-emphasis for non-selected siblings only while another pin is selected; remains interactive | | `isResolved` | `boolean` | `false` | resolved pins render nothing unless selected | | `isDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | disabled marker: aria-disabled, keeps its tab stop, blocks every activation path | | `onClick` | `MouseEventHandler` | - | host activation handler | | `xstyle` | `StyleXStyles` | - | root layout/positioning styles; marker owns no coordinates | ## Examples ### Single thread ```tsx openThread('thread-1')} /> ``` ### Grouped threads ```tsx setSelectedCluster('cluster-1')} /> ``` ### Unread threads with participant overflow ```tsx // Five distinct people: two Avatars plus an ellipsis circle. // Two unread threads: an accent dot after the total. setSelectedCluster('cluster-2')} /> ``` ### Sizes ```tsx ``` ### Host-owned placement ```tsx const positions = stylex.create({ marker: { position: 'absolute', insetInlineStart: '42%', insetBlockStart: '28%', transform: 'translateY(-100%)', }, });
``` ## Theming | Component class | Preferred data attributes | Props | States | |-----------------|---------------------------|-------|--------| | `astryx-comment-pin` | `data-size`, `data-grouped`, `data-unread`, `data-selected`, `data-dimmed`, `data-resolved`, `data-disabled` | size, grouped, unread, selected, dimmed, resolved, disabled | - | Override in defineTheme: ```ts components: { 'comment-pin': { base: { /* CSS properties */ }, 'size:value': { /* variant-specific */ }, }, } ```
